summary: Angled bays beside KFC at the street end; busy and exposed, apartments 17 m.

best_section.where: Angled bays on Underhill Avenue's west kerb just south of Moggill Road

drivers.seclusion: Commercial: KFC, shops and a service yard; apartments about 17 m at the south end. Roadworks plant visible at the north end.
drivers.access_and_room: Marked angle bays with a clear aisle; a van up to 7.5 m will overhang a standard bay.
drivers.traffic: Close to Moggill Road and drive-through traffic; busy during the day.
drivers.convention: Mapped 1/2P angle parking 9am-5pm daily, so the night is unrestricted; No Stopping Any Time signs at the ends.

flags: No Stopping Any Time signs at both ends of the bays

sun_shade: Mostly open; the building to the east shades the afternoon.
